contentItem.title: 等量关系：平面与三角形与角
contentItem.englishTitle: If there be three plane angles of which two, taken together in any manner, are greater than the remaining one, and they are contained by equal straight lines, it is possible to construct a triangle out of the straight lines joining the extremities of the equal straight lines.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: If there be three plane angles of which two, taken together in any manner, are greater than the remaining one, and they are contained by equal straight lines, it is possible to construct a triangle out of the straight lines joining the extremities of the equal straight lines.
如果有三个平面角度,其中两个角度以任何方式加在一起,大于其余的角,并且它们由相等的直线组成,那么就有可能在连接相同直线的极端的直线外建立一个三角形。

Let there be three plane angles ABC, DEF, GHK, of which two, taken together in any manner, are greater than the remaining one, namely the angles ABC, DEF greater than the angle GHK, the angles DEF, GHK greater than the angle ABC, and, further, the angles GHK, ABC greater than the angle DEF; let the straight lines AB, BC, DE, EF, GH, HK be equal, and let AC, DF, GK be joined; I say that it is possible to construct a triangle out of straight lines equal to AC, DF, GK, that is, that any two of the straight lines AC, DF, GK are greater than the remaining one.
3 平面 ABC,DEF,GHK角度,其中两个角度,以任何方式加起来,均大于其余一个角度,即ABC,DEF比GHK角度大,DEF,GHK比ABC角度大,GHK,ABC角度比DEF角度大;AB,BC,DE,EF,GH,HK直线等同,AC,DF,GK连接;我说,有可能在直线之外建造一个三角形,等于AC、DF、GK,也就是说,任何两条直线都大于其余一条直线。
Now, if the angles ABC, DEF, GHK are equal to one another, it is manifest that, AC, DF, GK being equal also, it is possible to construct a triangle out of straight lines equal to AC, DF, GK.
如果角度ABC,DEF,GHK是等同的,那么很明显,如果角度ABC,DF,GK(如果等同),那么可以用直线建造一个三角形,直线等于AC,DF,GK。

But, if not, let them be unequal, and on the straight line HK, and at the point H on it, let the angle KHL be constructed equal to the angle ABC; let HL be made equal to one of the straight lines AB, BC, DE, EF, GH, HK, and let KL, GL be joined.
但是,如果不是,则要使它们不平等,在HK线上,在H线上,让KHL角等于ABC角;让HL角等于AB、BC、DE、EF、GH、HK直线之一,让KL、GL开关。
Now, since the two sides AB, BC are equal to the two sides KH, HL, and the angle at B is equal to the angle KHL, therefore the base AC is equal to the base KL. [[I. 4](/principles/euclid-1-4)]
现在,既然双方AB,BC等于双方KH,HL,B的角等于KHL,因此底边,AC等于底边,KL。 [[I. 4](/principles/euclid-1-4)]
And, since the angles ABC, GHK are greater than the angle DEF, while the angle ABC is equal to the angle KHL, therefore the angle GHL is greater than the angle DEF.
由于角度ABC,GHK大于角度DEF, 而角度ABC等于角度KHL, 因此角度GHL大于角度DEF。

And, since the two sides GH, HL are equal to the two sides DE, EF, and the angle GHL is greater than the angle DEF, therefore the base GL is greater than the base DF. [[I. 24](/principles/euclid-1-24)]
由于双方GH,HL等于双方DE,EF,GHL角度大于DEF角度,因此底边,GL角度大于底边,DF角度。 [[I. 24](/principles/euclid-1-24)]
But GK, KL are greater than GL.
但GK,KL 大于GL。
Therefore GK, KL are much greater than DF.
因此,GK,KL比DF要多得多。
But KL is equal to AC; therefore AC, GK are greater than the remaining straight line DF.
但KL等于AC;因此,AC,GK大于其余的DF直线。
Similarly we can prove that AC, DF are greater than GK, and further DF, GK are greater than AC.
同样,我们可以证明,AC,DF大于GK,还有DF,GK大于AC。
Therefore it is possible to construct a triangle out of straight lines equal to AC, DF, GK. Q. E. D.
因此,可以用直线建造一个三角形,直线等于AC,DF,GK。
